description: This file defines the interface for a factory class that creates IMediaKeys instances for IPC communication within the Rialto client media subsystem. It includes declarations for creating media keys objects based on a specified key system.

classes.name: IMediaKeysIpcFactory
classes.description: A factory class that provides methods to create IMediaKeys instances for IPC, returning shared pointers to the factory and unique pointers to media keys objects.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Static method to create and return a shared pointer to an IMediaKeysIpcFactory instance.

methods.name: createMediaKeysIpc
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create a media keys object for IPC based on the provided key system string.
